items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: He was on the Rabbit Foot Show with me.

ctx.x: He's from here and this is Herbert Shotwell, he's from Beaumont, Texas. This is Freddie Coleman from Natchez, Mississippi, he's a guitar player. This is Herbert Shotwell from Beaumont, Texas, a bass player. He was on the Rabbit Foot Show with me. Oh yeah.
